title: Analysis, Not Transcript Echoes
summary: The app upgrade is live. Deep AI still needs API credits; failed research no longer masquerades as a completed analysis.
discord_changes: Animated progress + lead researcher, parallel specialists and independent review.
Transcript-copy summaries are rejected; all 17 Monday Brief sections stay in order.
Mobile release checks repaired. Deep AI remains blocked until API credit is restored.
changes: Connected the v0.31 specialist pipeline to the actual Analyse form and ordered report.
Replaced transcript-copy summaries and takeaways with mandatory model-backed synthesis and source receipts.
Added a lead researcher, parallel summary/takeaway/structure/claims specialists, editorial review, remake and final review.
Added a bounded revision cycle and tests for literal copying, missing list items, quote grounding and runtime coverage.
Animated real task progress without an artificial minimum-duration delay.
Prevented missing-model and failed-review results from receiving 100% completion or entering the reviewed vault.
Preserved the Monday Brief's 17-section order and full transcript at the bottom.
Added claims-ledger output and original direction-specific remake beat sheets.
Made report exports reflect the displayed report and its incomplete status.
Fixed two pre-existing JavaScript syntax errors and the misplaced navigation insertion.
Stopped the obsolete first-visit tour from covering the mobile Analyse button.
Reduced mobile navigation to Analyse, Competitors and Vault.
Removed duplicate legacy model review and stale release-status overrides.
Expanded CI to every frontend JavaScript module and added deployed-site browser evidence.
Removed the delayed legacy account version overwrite; the current loader owns release readiness, and active analysis cannot be re-enabled by that auth UI.
known_limitations: Live backend retest on 8 September 2026 returned CREDIT_BALANCE_EXHAUSTED.
Fixture tests verify control flow and rejection behavior, not real model output quality.
Storyboard proxies and caption cues do not establish exhaustive original-frame or acoustic analysis.
why_it_matters: Explanation, application and source evidence must be distinct. An empty API balance or rejected output now leaves an explicit incomplete report instead of transcript filler.
